text: Seven AM... and every phone in the colony rang together.
Lallan Seth took loan! Recovery will happen!
Seth ji's gossip... for me? <gasp>
I'm not home... I'm just rice.
Seth ji!
It all began yesterday... in just two minutes.
Ninety-eight, ninety-nine... count again. Not one rupee less!
Small shop, big belly. Shop needs extension!
Bigger shop? I'm making space already!
Loan in two minutes! No paperwork!
Two minutes? My chai takes longer to cool!
Seth ji, what is a loan?
Loan means... others' money, my shop!
Just allow access to your contacts.
Just contacts? Take them! Free of cost!
And your photo gallery too.
Take photos too! Who's more handsome than me?
And please read these terms... carefully.
May I say? Read the terms, Seth ji!
Reading takes time. And time is money!
Congratulations! Loan approved!
Asked twenty thousand... only thirteen came?
Seven thousand processing fee, Seth ji!
And repay in seven days... thirty thousand!
In seven days my shop will double!
From today, Lallan Seth... Loan Seth!
Lawn? Wah! Where will you grow the grass, Seth ji?
Not grass, Masterji! Loan! Money!
Seth ji, freezer is big or door is small, no?
Seth ji, where did so much money come from?
God gave... in two minutes.
Money in two minutes? This is my dream!
We're live! Seth ji's brand new freezer!
That night... interest stayed awake. And so did Seth ji.
Twelve o'clock... twenty-one thousand!
One o'clock... twenty-two thousand!
Is this interest or an electricity meter?
Lakhan! Interest is growing every hour!
Science says... even interest sleeps at night.
Interest doesn't sleep, Lakhan... I don't sleep!
Seth ji... accounts tomorrow.
The app called every single contact of Seth ji.
Who is it? I fear nobody!
Pay Seth's money, or photo will go to everybody!
It's a phone, ji, not a lizard.
Everybody got a call, not me? Seth didn't save my number?
It's ringing! Hello? Yes, speaking... whole colony will see!
Evil eye on the phone!
Inquiry! ...About what?
Phone rings, auto dies. Wonderful...
Quiet!
Thirty years, not a word on Seth!
Did you hear? Seth took a loan!
I know. I got a call too.
Did you hear? Seth—
I know. Lemon is tied also.
Did you hear...?
We know, Aunty! Whole colony knows!
Hello, loan people? What else did Seth take?
Aunty, you are doing recovery?
No beta, I'll just get the news.
Seth ji! What is the whole colony saying?!
Where is Seth ji?
In the rice.
Bindu... I'm not in the sack.
It was only a two-minute loan, Bindu.
Two-minute loan... and phone calls to the whole colony?
They took my photo. They'll send it to everyone!
That's Papa's jalebi photo!
Now I will do the accounts.
No tension, Seth ji! I have another app!
To repay a loan... a new loan!
Really? In how many minutes?
...I was joking.
Loan upon loan? Stop, Tinku!
Dadi's aim... never misses.
Enough! Now I'll handle this.
First, evidence. Screenshot of every threat.
Then contacts and photo permission... off.
But I gave it free!
Quiet!
I have an idea! Real bank, let's go!
May I say? Cyber complaint at one-nine-three-zero!
Bank? Even sitting will cost a fee!
Let's go!
Let's go!
Seth ji, kindly adjust your belly... with interest.
<sigh> It only stops when it's urgent.
Push harder! I'm counting.
First tell me... no fee for sitting?
Madam, the app raises interest daily and threatens everyone.
May I say? No app gets contacts or photos. Ever.
Borrow only from a bank or RBI-registered company.
And my app... was that registered?
Threatened? Call one-nine-three-zero, or cybercrime dot gov dot in.
Cyber crime helpline. Please tell, what happened?
Loan app is threatening. We have all screenshots.
Well done. Complaint is registered, number will come by message.
And... any fee?
No fee.
Right loan for the shop, with right papers.
Madam, your advice... not one rupee less!
That evening Seth ji organised a Satyanarayan Katha.
O God, let no phone ring today.
First chapter of the katha... listen carefully.
Here... the recovery men!
Remember the plan? Three... two... one!
Seth ji is doing puja!
Prayers? Payment when?!
Complaint done on one-nine-three-zero. Whole colony is witness!
And I... fear nobody!
Not scared of threats... scared of a lizard.
Beta, what's your name? Tomorrow the whole colony will know.
Evil eye on all the phones!
Prasad? ...Inquiry!
I'm hungry! God will forgive.
We're live! World's first anti-loan aarti!
Quiet!
So... the first chapter of the katha.
Seth ji, now you're not alone.
The whole colony... and no fee.
Next morning... not one phone rang in the colony.
Inquiry done! Cyber cell has registered the complaint.
App is reported. Threatening phones are shut.
So... no need to pay thirty thousand?
No interest on threats. Return only what you got.
Thirteen thousand... in full. Not one rupee less...
My contacts, my photos. Not any app's!
Science says, delete the app, delete the loan!
May I say? Repay the real debt. Don't tolerate threats.
And the shop will grow... from a bank, with proper papers!
Dadaji, a two-minute loan... made me cry for two days.
Quick money makes you cry for long.
Borrow only from a bank or RBI-registered place. After reading terms.
Never give apps contacts or photos. Threats? One-nine-three-zero.
Not 'time is money'... 'reading is money'!
Not one word less... I'll read everything!
Loan in two minutes!
Colony tales... see you soon!
